title: Buffalo Grove Days festival scheduled for September 3 to 7 at Mike Rylko Community Park
text:
Buffalo Grove Days festival scheduled for September 3 to 7 at Mike Rylko Community Park
Buffalo Grove Days is set to return from September 3 to 7, 2026, at Mike Rylko Community Park. The event will feature five days of food, music, and activities for attendees of all ages and abilities.
The festival will open on Thursday with carnival hours from 6 to 10 p.m. and Rotary Bingo starting at 6:30 p.m. On Friday, the carnival will run from 6 to 11 p.m., with live performances by Hi Infidelity from 6 to 8 p.m. and The Brothers Gibb from 8:30 to 10 p.m.
Saturday’s schedule includes a community blood drive at the Alcott Center beginning at 8 a.m., the Buffalo Grove Days Parade at Buffalo Grove Road and Deerfield Parkway starting at 11:30 a.m., as well as business and craft fairs, kids’ entertainment, Paint & Sip sessions, and a Buddy Baseball Exhibition Game that requires pre-registration. Live music acts include performances by 7th Heaven, Sounds of Seattle, and 16 Candles throughout the afternoon and evening.
Sunday offers another day of carnival rides between 1 and 11 p.m., along with events such as a dog show at Willow Stream Park in the morning, additional business fairs, blood drives at the Fitness Center in the afternoon requiring appointments, Puzzle Palooza (pre-registration required), line dancing lessons, bags tournament play, and the Buffalo Grove Rotary Duck Race streamed live on Facebook. Musical entertainment features Nashville Electric, LP Vinyl, and Rod Tuffcurls and the Benchpress.
The final day on Monday includes fun activities that require registration from morning until noon, followed by Turning Down Today performing live music between noon and three o’clock. Carnival rides are available until early evening.
Organizers note that all activities are subject to change or cancellation. For further updates or information about parking options or frequently asked questions regarding Buffalo Grove Days events or registration requirements for specific activities such as the Buddy Baseball Exhibition Game or Puzzle Palooza, participants are encouraged to visit www.bgdays.com.
